seo.title: Vence: 16 kWp and 15 kWh on a villa | Soliance
seo.description: Contemporary villa in Vence: 32 panels on a flat roof, Solax IES inverter and 15 kWh battery. Need, solution, process and expected results.

vence-villa-16-kwc.title: 16 kWp and 15 kWh of storage for a villa that uses 38,000 kWh per year.

blocks.need: Large villa with a pool, electricity for heating and water, a bill of about €300 per month. Goal: reduce reliance on the grid without selling anything back.
blocks.solution: 32 La Francilienne 500 W panels on the flat roof on K2 S-Dome ballast, Solax IES X3 15 kW three-phase hybrid inverter, 15 kWh battery.
blocks.process: Study based on real consumption and roof orientation, prior declaration at the town hall, Enedis connection request, fitted by our technicians on 17 February 2026, Consuel and commissioning.
blocks.followUp: Soliance Care monitoring from commissioning; 96% of the production used on site according to the study, real figures published after 12 months.

seo.title: 148 kWp in collective self-consumption | Soliance
seo.description: Solis Invest office building: 148 kWp on a flat roof, production shared with the tenant companies. Need, solution and technical sheet.

immeuble-bureaux-148-kwc.title: 148 kWp on an office building: the owner becomes the electricity supplier of its tenants.

blocks.need: A multi-tenant public-access commercial building, a large unused flat roof and occupying companies exposed to rising electricity prices. The owner wants to add value to the building without selling to EDF OA.
blocks.solution: 148 kWp: ≈ 330 La Francilienne 450 W full black panels on K2 S-Dome ballast (without piercing the waterproofing), Solax X3 Pro 150 kVA inverter, perimeter guardrail. Collective self-consumption scheme: the owner is the producer, the tenants the consumers.
blocks.process: Yield and load study, ballast calculation note, set-up of the organising legal entity, agreement with Enedis, installation, commissioning and allocation keys between tenants.
blocks.result: About 190 MWh produced per year (1,300 kWh/kWp baseline), used first by the tenants, surplus sold. Soliance Care monitoring across the whole plant.

seo.title: Pertuis: 163 kWp on the municipal gym | Soliance
seo.description: Asset-based collective self-consumption in Pertuis: 163 kWp on the gym supply the town's buildings. Need, solution and process.

pertuis-gymnase-163-kwc.title: 163 kWp on the gym: the town produces the electricity of its own buildings.

blocks.need: A town with a stock of energy-hungry buildings (gym, school, town hall, floodlit stadium) and a large unused south-facing steel-sheet roof.
blocks.solution: 163 kWp mounted over both slopes of the roof, Solax X3 Forth inverters in an outdoor cabinet, “asset-based” collective self-consumption scheme: the town is both producer and consumer across its delivery points.
blocks.process: Yield study and mapping of the buildings' consumption, Enedis application for the sharing perimeter, installation completed on 26 May 2026 without interrupting the gym's activity, commissioning and allocation keys.
blocks.result: About 210 MWh produced per year (1,300 kWh/kWp baseline), shared between the connected municipal buildings; Soliance Care monitoring.

seo.title: Séranon: 36 kWp on a Spar supermarket roof | Soliance
seo.description: Spar supermarket in Séranon: 36 kWp without a battery, 88% of the production used on site and a third of the store's electricity produced on its roof.

seranon-spar-36-kwc.eyebrow: Self-consumption with surplus resale · Séranon (06) · October 2024
seranon-spar-36-kwc.title: 36 kWp on a Spar: a third of the store's electricity produced on its roof.

blocks.need: A village supermarket at 1,100 m altitude using 155,000 kWh per year, mostly during the day (refrigerated displays, cold rooms, lighting). A bill that follows the price per kWh, and a south-facing steel-sheet roof.
blocks.solution: 72 full black 500 W panels mounted over the roof (36 kWp), 30° tilt due south, Solax X3 Pro inverter, no battery: the store's consumption profile absorbs the production directly. The surplus (12%) is sold to the grid.
blocks.process: Yield and consumption study in September 2024 (terrain and distant shading taken into account), prior declaration, Enedis connection, fitted by our technicians, commissioned on 28 October 2024.
blocks.result: 53,000 kWh produced per year, 88% used on site, 33% store self-sufficiency over the year, payback in under 3 years. About 1 tonne of CO₂ avoided every year.

panel.title: Why it works without a battery
panel.text: A shop consumes when the sun produces: refrigeration runs all day, doors open, tills operate. The production curve follows the consumption curve, hence 88% direct self-consumption, where a house reaches 30% without storage.

seo.title: Vence: 28.5 kWp and 35 kWh of battery | Soliance
seo.description: Villa with a pool in Vence: 57 panels, Solax X3 Ultra inverter and 35 kWh of T58 batteries, our largest residential battery.

vence-villa-28-kwc.title: 28.5 kWp and 35 kWh of storage: the largest residential battery we have fitted.

blocks.need: Family villa with a pool and pool house, 32,000 kWh used per year with winter peaks. The client wants to cover almost all needs, evenings included, without relying on resale.
blocks.solution: 57 La Francilienne 500 W full black panels spread over the villa's south slopes and the pool house, Solax X3 Ultra 30 kW three-phase hybrid inverter, 6 Solax T58 batteries (35 kWh), EPS backup box and protection boxes in the garage.
blocks.process: Slope-by-slope shading study (layout over 3 roofs), prior declaration, three-phase Enedis connection, fitted by our technicians on 24 June 2026, Consuel, battery / grid priority settings.
blocks.result: 36,000 kWh produced per year, 70% expected self-sufficiency (study), bill divided by 2.6; Soliance Care monitoring from commissioning.

seo.title: Vergers Niçois: 15 kWp on a farm shed | Soliance
seo.description: Farm in Saint-Laurent-du-Var: 15 kWp on a steel-sheet shed and 12 kWh of battery for the cold room, the workshop and irrigation.

saint-laurent-du-var-hangar-agricole-15-.eyebrow: Self-consumption with storage · Vergers Niçois · Saint-Laurent-du-Var (06) · June 2025
saint-laurent-du-var-hangar-agricole-15-.title: 15 kWp and 12 kWh on a farm shed: refrigeration runs on the sun by day and on the battery at night.

blocks.need: A local market gardener and fruit grower with a cold room, a workshop and irrigation pumps: steady consumption all year round, summer peaks at harvest, and an unused south-facing steel-sheet shed.
blocks.solution: 15 kWp of full black panels mounted over the steel sheet, Solax X3 three-phase hybrid inverter, 2 Solax T58 batteries (12 kWh) and a DC box in the plant room: the farm uses its production directly and the battery covers the cold room at night.
blocks.process: Study of the farm's consumption (refrigeration, irrigation, workshop), prior declaration, Enedis connection, fitted by our technicians on 12 June 2025 without interrupting activity, Consuel approved on 3 December, commissioned on 11 December 2025.
blocks.result: About 19,500 kWh produced per year (1,300 kWh/kWp baseline); Soliance Care monitoring. A neighbour of our showroom: it is also our local showcase.

seo.title: La Colle-sur-Loup: solar and Daikin heat pump | Soliance
seo.description: Villa in La Colle-sur-Loup: 13 kWp, 15 kWh of battery and a 16 kW Daikin Altherma heat pump fitted together. The house is heated by its roof.

la-colle-sur-loup-pac-13-kwc.eyebrow: Solar + battery + air-to-water heat pump · La Colle-sur-Loup (06) · May 2026
la-colle-sur-loup-pac-13-kwc.title: 13 kWp, 15 kWh and a 16 kW Daikin heat pump: the house is heated by its roof.

blocks.need: Villa with a pool and a heating system to replace. Rather than two separate jobs, the client wants a single consistent installation: produce, store, and heat with the electricity produced.
blocks.solution: 26 La Francilienne 500 W panels, Solax X1 IES inverter with 15 kWh of battery, and a 16 kW Daikin Altherma air-to-water heat pump with a buffer tank in the plant room. The heat pump runs on solar during the day, the battery takes over in the evening.
blocks.process: Solar study and thermal study, prior declaration with heritage (ABF) approval on 13 April 2026, MaPrimeRénov' application for the heat pump, both lots fitted by our teams in May 2026, Consuel approved on 7 August.
blocks.result: About 16,900 kWh produced per year (1,300 kWh/kWp baseline): enough to cover the heat pump in mid-season and a large share of winter heating; Soliance Care monitoring on both systems.

images.villa: Villa in La Colle-sur-Loup, panels on the roof, pool
images.bufferTank: Buffer tank and Daikin hydraulic module in the plant room

panel.title: Why pair solar and a heat pump
panel.text: A heat pump uses 3 to 4 times less than conventional electric heating, and it mostly runs during the day. With 13 kWp on the roof and 15 kWh of battery, every solar kWh replaces heating oil or gas instead of being sold for a cent.
